description: The user's open and recent requests (questions, quotes, samples, documents, complaints) with one business or with all of them: what was asked, when, where it stands, and the business's reply when there is one. Use it when the user asks whether a business has answered or what is pending.

business.description: Name of the business as it appears in list_my_businesses. Used only when business_id is not given. Leave both out when the user has one business, or to search every business the user has.

business_id.description: The business id exactly as given by list_my_businesses (for example yyigsmj5b7mcwxe7). Preferred: use it whenever you know it.

name: status
title: Status of my requests
